body:
Amanitas Up!
I was in Arcata, California and I was visiting my grandma and I decided to go for a walk in the woods to look for amanita muscarias. Instead I found 2 adult amanita pantherinas. I took them and froze them and put them into an ice chest and didn't eat them until we got home. Then I slow boiled them to perfection but they still tasted like fishy shit and I almost puked, actually I did puke and that made me puke more.
15 minutes after I puked I started to feel heavy and delirious about everything so I got up to go to the bathroom and I swear I thought I would fall through the floor. Luckily it was just me trippin balls after that. About an hour into the trip I started to feel really dreamy and tired like a twilight trip and everything was vibrating and shaky feeling. About the 2nd hour into the trip I was really trippin and everything started to melt and fade in and out. I started feeling nausea rizing so I took some liquid phenagran or promethazine and it made me puke even more. This was how I tripped for the rest of the time until about the 6th hour and I passed out and woke up two hours later really groggy.
I would love to try amanitas again someday but for now I am going to try to keep my head in school.
